name: V2149 Ori

planets.name: B
planets.note: known F8 ~2.1 Msun near-equal binary at 0.365"; measurable orbital motion since 2001 consistent with a bound orbit

images.wavelength_label: H band 1.6 um (total intensity; companion detection)
images.credit: Valegard et al. 2024, Fig. 1 thumbnail (crop); companion detected, no disk in polarized light

paper.title: Disk Evolution Study Through Imaging of Nearby Young Stars (DESTINYS): The SPHERE view of the Orion star-forming region

notes: G0+F7 known double in the Orion star-forming region; the held SPHERE/IRDIS H-band total-intensity image recovers the stellar companion at a separation measurably larger than the 0.33 arcsec found in December 2001 by Koehler et al. (2006), while no disk is detected in polarized light (Valegard et al. 2024).
